entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
I want to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought a little over two weeks ago. It's just not working out for me.
I understand. I can certainly help you with a return. Can I get your order number, please?
Ugh, hold on... Okay, it's VF7892345.
Thank you. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse. Our standard return policy is 90 days for a full refund, so you're well within that window.
90 days? Great! Because the website wasn't very clear. I was worried I was stuck with this thing. It keeps disconnecting from my phone. I really thought it would be a great smart watch.

I apologize for any confusion regarding our return policy. Sometimes that information can be difficult to find. To initiate the return, I will email you a prepaid shipping label. Just pack up the VeloBand Pulse and drop it off at your nearest shipping location.
Perfect! That sounds easy enough. How long will it take to get the refund?
Once we receive the VeloBand Pulse, please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to be processed and credited back to your original payment method.
Okay, that's reasonable. So just to confirm, I have 90 days from today to ship it back, right?

That's correct. You have 90 days from today. The return policy applies from the purchase date, which you're well within. If you have any issues printing the shipping label, or if you don’t receive it in the next 24 hours, don't hesitate to call us back. If you need to escalate the issue to a manager, we will facilitate this for you.
Fantastic! Thank you so much for your help. I was really dreading this call.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
